_comment: Canonical fork identity. Single source of truth for every place cmux Mochi differs from upstream cmux in name, bundle id, URL scheme, update feed, or signing. Generated artifacts (config/ForkIdentity.xcconfig, scripts/fork-identity.env) are produced from this file by scripts/inject-fork-identity.sh -- never edit those by hand. Prose context lives in FORK.md.

upstream._comment: Recorded so --check can scan for upstream identity that leaked back in after a rebase.
